description: This Java test class `AuthorServiceTest` contains unit tests for the `AuthorService` class in a book management application. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito to mock dependencies and verify behavior, testing methods like findById, save, delete, and others related to author management.

classes.name: AuthorServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the `AuthorService` which verifies behavior of author-related operations using mock repository.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the `AuthorService` with a mocked `AuthorRepository` before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that calling `findById` with null throws a `NullPointerException` and that repository's `findById` is not invoked.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Checks that `findById` with a non-null ID properly interacts with the repository.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that `findAll` calls the repository's `findAll` method.

methods.name: save_throwsException_ifAuthorIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that saving null throws an exception and that repository's `save` is not called.

methods.name: authorSavedIfNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that a valid `Author` object is successfully passed to the repository's `save` method.

methods.name: delete_throwsException_ifAuthorIsNull
methods.description: Checks that deleting null throws an exception and that repository's `delete` is not called.

methods.name: authorDeletedIfNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that a valid `Author` object is correctly passed to the repository's `delete` method.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that calling `deleteAll` on the service invokes the repository's `deleteAll`.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that calling `count` on the service invokes the repository's `count`.
